claims.statement: Every scalar projection of the explicit centred planar Gaussian is convex-order dominated by the three-component mixture, but the explicit convex witness reverses joint expectations by more than 37/18432.
Adding 10^-8 I to all four covariances preserves projected order and gives joint witness gap >16213/11520000.
For weights p>2/3, q,r>0, p+q+r=1, compensated component scales yield an explicit nonempty separating threshold interval.
